title: Lending Guide: Interest Rate Buydown Election Conditions, Qualifying Rate and Cancellation
content:
### 1. When a buydown may be elected

1.1 An Interest Rate Buydown is elected only while the loan file status is processing, underwriting, conditionally approved or suspended. Once the file is cleared to close the buydown can no longer be added.

1.2 The status that counts is the status shown on Larkspur Home Lending's loan file record for the same loan file the buydown is elected on, as it stands before the election.

| Loan file status | Buydown may be elected |
|---|---|
| application received | No |
| disclosed | No |
| processing | Yes |
| underwriting | Yes |
| conditionally approved | Yes |
| suspended | Yes |
| clear to close | No |
| consummated | No |
| rescinded | No |
| withdrawn | No |
| denied | No |
| closed incomplete | No |

### 2. File and payer conditions

2.1 The loan file must meet the elected product's eligible loan programs, eligible loan purposes, eligible occupancies, eligible property types, minimum credit score, maximum loan-to-value and minimum loan term, and the payer must be among the product's permitted funding sources.

2.2 A seller or builder payer needs a purchase contract addendum.

2.3 A temporary buydown needs a buydown agreement signed by the borrower and the payer.

| Feature of the hypothetical buydown | What it needs under 2.2 and 2.3 |
|---|---|
| paid by a seller or a builder | a purchase contract addendum |
| temporary | a buydown agreement signed by the borrower and the payer |
| temporary and paid by a builder | a purchase contract addendum, and a buydown agreement signed by the borrower and the builder |

### 3. Qualifying rate

The borrower is always qualified at the note rate, never at a reduced rate. On a hypothetical file with a 6.875% note rate carrying a temporary buydown whose loan year 1 payment rate is 4.875%, the borrower is qualified at 6.875%.

### 4. Approval

A buydown moves from elected to approved when its eligibility, payer and amount are confirmed.

### 5. Cancellation and the Closing Disclosure

5.1 A buydown may be cancelled by the borrower until consummation without fee.

5.2 A change after the Closing Disclosure needs a corrected disclosure.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A loan file in suspended status: the buydown may be elected, so far as the file status goes.
- A loan file that has been cleared to close: the buydown can no longer be added.
- A borrower asks to drop an approved buydown before consummation: it may be cancelled without fee.
